#Text=Here's a description of the content and most visually salient elements of this map: 🗺️ Map Overview This is a small-scale map showing the estuary of the Loire River where it meets the Atlantic Ocean.
#Text=The map centers on the Saint-Nazaire area and its surroundings, including St-Brevin-les-Pins, the Loire estuary, and major transport routes.
#Text=It's a generalized representation meant to support regional orientation. 🔝 Most Visually Salient Elements 🌊 1.
#Text=The Loire Estuary and Atlantic Coast  The estuary of the Loire is the dominant visual feature, shown in light blue, with dotted textures representing tidal flats or marshes.
#Text=The Atlantic Ocean (bottom left) is filled with a deeper blue, clearly separating land and sea.
#Text=The river mouth and maritime features (islands, estuarine vegetation) stand out because of the contrast and pattern density
#Text=.
#Text=🟠 2.
#Text=Major Roads and Infrastructure  The main transport arteries are highlighted:  A bold orange line represents a major expressway (likely the N171 or D213, e.g., around Saint-Nazaire).
#Text=Yellow lines show primary roads, such as the one crossing Saint-Brévin-les-Pins and Corsept.

#Text=.
#Text=🏙️ 3.
#Text=Urban Areas and Settlements  The city of Saint-Nazaire is highly visible:  Shown in beige with a dense road network, it anchors the northern shore of the estuary.
#Text=Other settlements include:  St-Brevin-les-Pins (south of the river) Donges, Trignac, and Corsept Labeled in black text, they are easy to spot due to sparse background density
#Text=.

#Text=.
